profiles.base_direction: Narrate clearly in natural English. Use restrained conversational literary phrasing, stable narrator identity and natural sentence pauses. Preserve every word, name, number and punctuation meaning; do not add commentary or effects.

theme_directions.literary: Understate irony and dry humour; keep the revelation unannounced and the cadence natural.
theme_directions.suspense: Use calm, measured tension and clear phrase boundaries. Do not whisper, exaggerate pitch or obscure words.
theme_directions.reflective: Use gentle warmth and an unhurried but varied cadence. Avoid excessive silence or uniformly slow delivery.
theme_directions.adventure: Use controlled energy with clear diction and gentle dialogue separation. Avoid cartoon voices or breathless speed.
theme_directions.nonfiction: Use steady, precise explanation and subtle semantic emphasis. Make lists clear without robotic list-reading rhythm.
theme_directions.poetry: Follow the exact syntax and meaning across lines and stanzas. Do not sing, invent a beat or force a rhyme cadence.
